title: dont repeat password email fields
rule: Don’t repeat password/email fields; confirm on a later page instead.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Registration and Login Forms on Mobile

pass_when: Email and password are each asked once; confirmation is a later page, not a second identical field.
fail_when: Confirm-email or confirm-password duplicate fields on the same form.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
